title: Èmi bá ní ẹgbẹ̀rún ahọ́n
title_en: O for a Thousand Tongues to Sing
review_notes: Photo-backed traditional text; minor diacritics and phrasing may differ from book. Review before public use.
verses: Jésù tó ṣe ẹ̀rù wa d'ayọ̀
Ẹ̀jẹ̀ Rẹ lè wẹ ẹlẹ́rí mọ́
Ó sọ̀rọ̀, òkú gbọ́ ohùn Rẹ
Kí n lè rò ká gbogbo ayé
verses_en: O for a thousand tongues to sing
The glories of my God and King,
Jesus! the name that charms our fears,
He breaks the power of cancelled sin,
His blood can make the foulest clean,
He speaks, and listening to His voice,
Hear Him, ye deaf; His praise, ye dumb,
Ye blind, behold your Saviour come;
And leap, ye lame, for joy.
My gracious Master and my God,
To spread through all the earth abroad
